name: brokerverse
description: BrokerVerse - insurance broking core platform by iorta TechNXT

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w shared && npm run coverage -w server && npm run coverage -w web
